headerDisplay: GivHome brings Intelligent Octopus Go smart charging to your GivEnergy battery — automatically, locally, and beautifully inside Apple Home.

inverterSerial.title: Battery Serial Number
inverterSerial.description: Find this in the GivEnergy app: Settings → Local Monitoring → Scan for your inverter. This is the battery/inverter serial used by GivTCP topics.

maxPvKw.title: Maximum Solar Power (kW)
maxPvKw.description: Maximum PV/solar output used to scale the Solar Power tile. Example: 2.88 for a 2.88 kW array.

octopusAccountNumber.title: Octopus Account Number
octopusAccountNumber.description: For Intelligent Octopus Go smart dispatch windows. Usually starts with A-. Leave blank only if you want monitoring/manual control/off-peak scheduling without Octopus dispatch.

octopusApiKey.title: Octopus API Key
octopusApiKey.description: Find this in your Octopus Energy online account under Developer Settings / API access. Used only to read Intelligent Octopus Go dispatch windows; leave blank only if not using IOG dispatch.

targetSoc.title: Target Charge %
targetSoc.description: Default battery target for automatic and manual charge slots. Leave at 100 unless you intentionally want a lower target.

cheapStart.title: Off-Peak Start
cheapStart.description: Default Intelligent Octopus Go off-peak start time. Leave at 23:30 unless your tariff differs.

cheapEnd.title: Off-Peak End
cheapEnd.description: Default Intelligent Octopus Go off-peak end time. Leave at 05:30 unless your tariff differs.

graceMinutes.title: Grace Period
graceMinutes.description: After an Octopus smart dispatch ends, continue only until the end of the current half-hour period (:00 or :30). Leave at 30 for this behaviour.

name.title: Homebridge Platform Name
name.description: Advanced. Optional internal Homebridge platform name. Leave blank for the default GivHome naming; Home tiles use simple labels such as Charge 60m and Export 90m.

mqttUrl.title: MQTT URL
mqttUrl.description: Advanced. Local MQTT broker used by GivTCP telemetry. Leave unchanged for the standard Pi/Homebridge setup.

mqttUsername.title: MQTT Username
mqttUsername.description: Advanced. Only needed if your MQTT broker requires authentication.

mqttPassword.title: MQTT Password
mqttPassword.description: Advanced. Only needed if your MQTT broker requires authentication.

mqttRootTopic.title: MQTT Root Topic
mqttRootTopic.description: Advanced. Root MQTT topic published by GivTCP.

givTcpRestUrl.title: GivTCP Local Address
givTcpRestUrl.description: Advanced. Local GivTCP REST control endpoint. Leave unchanged unless GivTCP is running on another device. If you need to locate your inverter, use the GivEnergy app: Settings → Local Monitoring → Scan for your inverter.

octopusPollSeconds.title: Octopus Polling Seconds
octopusPollSeconds.description: Advanced. How often the plugin checks Octopus for updated smart charging windows.

slotToleranceMinutes.title: Manual Tile Tolerance Minutes
slotToleranceMinutes.description: Advanced. Tolerance used when deciding which manual duration tile should show On from the live inverter slot.

powerActiveThreshold.title: Legacy Power Active Threshold W
powerActiveThreshold.description: Advanced legacy fallback only. New installs should use the separate activity thresholds below.

staleSeconds.title: Telemetry Stale Seconds
staleSeconds.description: Advanced. How long MQTT telemetry can be silent before the inverter is shown as offline.

smartWindowsJson.title: Manual Smart Windows JSON
smartWindowsJson.description: Advanced fallback only. Optional extra cheap windows, e.g. [{"start":"13:30","end":"15:00"}].

forceChargeMinutes.title: Legacy Force Charge Minutes
forceChargeMinutes.description: Legacy compatibility only. Home tiles now provide 30, 60, 90, and 120 minute charge options.

forceExportMinutes.title: Legacy Force Export Minutes
forceExportMinutes.description: Legacy compatibility only. Home tiles now provide 30, 60, 90, and 120 minute export options.

chargeActiveThresholdW.title: Charging Active Threshold W
chargeActiveThresholdW.description: Advanced. Grid or smart charging sensor threshold in watts. Raised by default to reduce Home app notification noise from tiny battery-breathing events.

solarChargeActiveThresholdW.title: Solar Charging Active Threshold W
solarChargeActiveThresholdW.description: Advanced. Solar-to-battery charging sensor threshold in watts. Kept lower so useful UK winter solar charging is still visible.

dischargeActiveThresholdW.title: Discharging Active Threshold W
dischargeActiveThresholdW.description: Advanced. Battery discharging is shown as active above this wattage.

importActiveThresholdW.title: Importing Active Threshold W
importActiveThresholdW.description: Advanced. Grid importing is shown as active above this wattage.

exportActiveThresholdW.title: Exporting Active Threshold W
exportActiveThresholdW.description: Advanced. Exporting sensor threshold in watts. Raised by default to avoid Home app notification noise from brief battery breathing or load-drop overspill.

updateCheckEnabled.title: Update Available Sensor
updateCheckEnabled.description: Advanced. Enables the GivHome Update Available Home tile. It checks the npm registry periodically for a newer plugin release.

updatePollHours.title: Update Check Hours
updatePollHours.description: Advanced. How often GivHome checks for plugin updates.

updateCheckUrl.title: Update Check URL
updateCheckUrl.description: Advanced. npm registry endpoint used by the Update Available sensor. Leave unchanged unless testing.

form.title: Required Setup
form.description: Most users only need these details.

form.title: Charging Behaviour
form.description: Defaults are set for Intelligent Octopus Go. Open only if you want to change target charge, off-peak times, or grace behaviour.

form.title: Advanced Local Connection
form.description: MQTT, GivTCP, and polling settings. Leave unchanged for the standard local setup.

form.title: Advanced Tuning
form.description: Rarely used tuning, activity thresholds, update checks, and compatibility settings.
